question: A cuboid has length 10 cm, breadth 5 cm and height 2 cm. What is its surface area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of Cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(10 × 5 + 5 × 2 + 2 × 10)

⇒ Surface Area = 2(50 + 10 + 20)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × 80 = 160

**∴ The correct answer is 160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 

 

 

 l = 10 cm
 h = 2 cm
 b = 5 cm

**Given:**

Length (l) = 10 cm

Breadth (b) = 5 cm

Height (h) = 2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (10 × 5 + 5 × 2 + 2 × 10)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (50 + 10 + 20)

⇒ Surface Area = 2 × (80)

⇒ Surface Area = 160 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 160 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cuboid

The amount of 3D space enclosed by the cuboid. Formula: V = l × b × h

Lateral Surface Area of a Cuboid

The total area of the four side walls, excluding the top and bottom rectangular faces. Formula: LSA = 2h(l + b)

Length of Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the longest possible straight line segment connecting two opposite corners inside the cuboid. Formula: d = √(l² + b² + h²)
